preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= vi <= 10**9 for vi in values)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value vi is within the range [-10^9, 10^9].

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of moves required to make all vertex values zero.
